title: Text: DET Courtney Foyt ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Have you heard anything definitive on TigerFest
It’s definitely not happening, but nothing definitive for annoucement
What about the other event for kids or what not... Is there no event, or just no “TigerFest” event
I think that got nixed too.
Ahh I guess we’re going to be planing a summerfest
Did you run that up the ladder today

No I just asked the promotions guy next to me. But a lot of things are like half said/ ideated and never happen so I don’t say it with a lot of confidence. I can only say with confidence that Tigerfest is not happening
Only reason I ask is because I can just wait a few days
Because I don’t want that promotions guy to potentially think, “Oh, Courtney just asked me about TigerFest”
